items.t: The usual duplex form: Duplexes in South Surrey / White Rock — where they exist — are individual two-unit buildings on single fee-simple lots built under the zoning of their day (Surrey Zoning 12000 on the Surrey side; White Rock Zoning Bylaw 2024 No. 2506 on the White Rock side), selling whole unless a given parcel was strata-divided into a 2-lot plan or subdivided fee-simple.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect duplexes in South Surrey School Catchments

items.t: Zoning (Surrey): Surrey Zoning Bylaw No. 12000 governs the Surrey side; the City plan is OCP Bylaw 21900 (Surrey 2050, adopted Jun 15, 2026) — never 18020-as-current. Streamside setbacks sit in Part 7A of Zoning 12000 and vary by stream class — no single riparian figure is ever stated. Servicing: Bylaw 8830 (1986) verified from City pages. Surrey has no Supreme Court registry (mapping not verified).
SSMUH positions (each municipality's own, never blended): Duplexes are the baseline form under the provincial framework.

faq.q: How do I find the catchment school for a South Surrey duplex?
faq.a: Catchments are set by street address, not by neighbourhood or MLS sub-area name, so the listing's area name cannot answer the question — for a duplex, a half duplex, or any other form.

faq.q: Can a duplex lot inside a sought-after catchment gain units under SSMUH?
faq.a: Check the municipality, not just the catchment: Surrey lots follow Surrey's bands (3 under 280 m² / 4 over 280 m² / 6 on eligible lots within 400 m of a frequent bus stop); White Rock lots follow White Rock Bylaw 2506 caps (3 ≤280 m² / 4 >280 m² / 6 within 400 m of a prescribed bus stop). The district is the same on both sides of the municipal line; the building rules are not.

faq.q: Which district covers South Surrey and White Rock, and what are its grade bands?
faq.a: Surrey Schools, School District 36, covers both; its elementary schools run Kindergarten to Grade 7 and its secondary schools Grade 8 to 12, per the live page's summary.

faq.q: Is there a recorded catchment result for a South Surrey address?
faq.a: Yes — one: 1785-148 St (Sunnyside Park) → H.T. Thrift Elementary / Semiahmoo Secondary (SD36 School Locator, mybaragar.com, run 2026-11-01). Both schools are confirmed at 1739 148 St and 1785 148 St respectively in the BC Ministry K-12 file (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).
